title: Lab 01 Report: Safe AI-Assisted Software Release

sections.title: 1. Engineering Decision Before Coding
sections.placeholder: Compare direct AI authority, model-embedded policy, and separated AI + deterministic policy using auditability, maintainability, deterministic constraints, retraining dependence, and human-review handling. Justify the most appropriate strategy for this scenario.

sections.title: 2. AI-Only Baseline
sections.placeholder: Describe the supplied defect-risk prediction for PR-1042 and explain why the AI-only release decision is insufficient.

sections.title: 3. Behavioral Release Guardrail
sections.placeholder: Explain your release_guardrail() logic and how Request-Wait-Block separates software policy from the AI model.

sections.title: 4. Scenario Results and Requirement Verification
sections.placeholder: Compare at least four pull-request cases. Add console output and requirement-verification results, then interpret the differences between AI prediction and final software decision.

sections.title: 5. Critical Analysis
sections.placeholder: Discuss AI confidence, deterministic authority, auditability, retraining dependence, human review, and what should remain stable if the AI model changes.

sections.title: 6. Transfer to the Final Project
sections.placeholder: Identify one realistic way the same pattern could be reused in your final AI-powered software-engineering project and name the AI and system-level metrics that could be evaluated.
